title: The Hem of the Robe
reflectionText: The man who had hunted him for years sat within reach in the dark of the cave, and David cut only the hem of his robe — and even that struck his heart. What is it to hold the power to end the one who is hunting you, and to let the hand that could have closed stay open?
editorialNotes: Wave 1a (Full-Canon Production Gate CG06). Picks up exactly where 1336 ends (David 'went up to the strongholds of En Gedi'). Cave-at-En-gedi scene only (1 Sam 24); the parallel 1 Sam 26 sparing at Hachilah is NOT imported. Distinct from 1448 (Cave of Adullam, 1 Sam 22). WEB 389w / KJV 397w in-bucket. Shared narrator with 1336 (VOICE_DAVID_SHEPHERD) is a deliberate arc-continuity choice, owner-approved. FULL added 2026-07-19 (ADR-030 supported-length evaluation), then corrective re-authored 2026-07-20 under ADR-031: the prior Full texts reproduced the anchor rather than retelling it (KJV Full was a verbatim contiguous reconstruction of all of 1 Samuel 24; WEB Full was 95.8% block-coverage near-reproduction with a 151-token unbroken source run). Both Fulls were fully re-authored as faithful spoken retellings that compress David's rebuttal (vv9-15) and Saul's reply (vv16-21) to their essential movements. Both preserve the central confrontation, the robe as evidence, David's refusal to raise his hand against the LORD's anointed, the appeal for divine judgment, the dead-dog/flea language, Saul's acknowledgment, the future kingship, the oath concerning Saul's seed and father's house, and the resolved v22 ending — without reproducing source sentence order. The proverb of the ancients (v13) is retained in the WEB Full but intentionally compressed out of the KJV Full; the KJV Full remains a complete, faithful retelling without it. Neither re-authored Full is reconstructible (WEB longest run 13 tokens / 57.7% coverage; KJV longest run 14 tokens / 71.4% coverage). WEB 507w / KJV 502w, in-bucket. Shorts and reflections unchanged. Full audio (audio_1564_story_full.mp3, audio_1564_story_kjv_full.mp3) re-rendered 2026-07-21 (Phase 2) from the corrected Full text via VOICE_DAVID_SHEPHERD / eleven_turbo_v2_5 at the locked settings; raw renders match corpus format (mp3 44100/128/mono), and the -18 LUFS compressed-mirror refresh is deferred to a later compress_audio.sh sweep. LONG was evaluated and OMITTED: 1 Samuel 24 contains ~617 words of scripture, and the strongest faithful draft reached only ~629w against the 901-word LONG floor — closing that gap would have required padding, restatement, or invented detail, which ADR-030 forbids. Boundary hard-stopped at v22; no material from 1 Sam 23 or 25.
